team_checks.reason: Per the requested H-batch relaxed standard, a complete men's first-team list requires every player to have name, position, shirt_number, nationality, season=2025/26, at least two public URLs, and at least one club-official URL. The live Real Madrid squad page and official shop player-number page now expose 2026/27 content, while the official 2025/26 sources located here are a signings feature and a single matchday call-up, not a complete season roster. The available Wayback snapshot URL returned no readable archived roster body. Transfermarkt can supply auxiliary 25/26 records but cannot replace the required complete official 2025/26 roster/number source. To avoid outputting an incomplete or mixed-season list, no players are emitted and the team is marked blocked_or_insufficient. Existing files were not modified.
